# Poisoned Apple

## Definition
The Poisoned Apple is a pivotal plot device in the fairy tale "Snow White," representing the deceit and treachery of the Evil Queen who uses it in her attempt to eliminate Snow White.

## Key Characteristics
- Symbolizes deceit and betrayal.
- Serves as a catalyst for the story's conflict.
- Represents the lengths to which the Queen will go to achieve her goals.
- Acts as a physical manifestation of the Queen's malice.

## Context
The Poisoned Apple is integral to the narrative of "Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs," illustrating themes of jealousy, the struggle between good and evil, and the consequences of vanity. It highlights the dangers of trust and the impact of malicious intentions within fairy tales.
